S.FORM: tu sumnis nani pasazi ta kawilian.
S.PHON: tu sumnis nani pasa[z|r]i ta kawirian
S.TRANSL: (He) came down and then went towards the left.

S.FORM: tu tmayta tu 'nay usiq yau a iki 'nay ta kinilan na lazan.
S.PHON: tu tmajta tu ʔnaj usiq jau a iki ʔnaj ta kiniran na ra[z|r]an
S.FORM: tu tmayta tu 'nay usiq yau a iki 'nay ta kinilan na lazan.
S.PHON: tu tmajta tu ʔnaj usiq jau a iki ʔnaj ta kiniran na ra[z|r]an
S.TRANSL: 看到有一個池塘在路的旁邊.
(He) saw that there was a pond by the road.

S.TRANSL: (He) continued walking and crossed the river.

And (he) saw that there was a paddy field in the place he passed by.
